purpose: Reduce inference wall time within the existing deadline; no performance-based model or criterion selection

trigger_evidence.other_observations: Per-row test generation throughput, training step counts and remaining time only; no new test scores inspected by parent for this decision
trigger_evidence.reason: Full36 plus preparation and serialization overhead risks exceeding the fixed absolute deadline

unchanged: All frozen data, test membership, gold, prompts and answer serialization
Three seeds,36 configurations, ordering, source message and parameter budgets
All training, optimizer updates, validation criterion and best-checkpoint selection
Strict numerical policy,24-token greedy limit, no KV cache, parser and metrics
Failure denominators, full-MAE null rule, paired contrasts and3/3 aggregation

engineering_version.grouping: Original frozen sample order in contiguous batches; last batch1to4; identical groups across models
engineering_version.raw_outputs: Keep complete returned token slots, first-EOS lengths, pad-tail lengths and original decoded text/parse
engineering_version.time_accounting: Whole-batch duration; no fabricated per-row duration split
engineering_version.communication: Record actual batch forwards, padded/valid queries and message bytes, including rows that reached EOS before batch completion
engineering_version.remaining_budget_difference: Realized calls vary with EOS; per-forward message and common24-forward maximum remain fixed, without dummy calls

qualification.inputs: TRAIN only, predetermined short/medium/long/longest prompts with sample-ID tie break
qualification.comparisons: Same reader state: B1 versus B4 and B2 tail batch; compare each row through first EOS, decoded text and strict parse
qualification.CPU_cases: Mixed EOS, pad equal/different from EOS, no EOS24-step limit, canonical/raw length and communication ledger
qualification.mismatch_action: Archive qualification failure; do not choose execution version using test outputs
qualification.scope: Strict determinism does not ensure batch-shape-invariant logits; equality on TRAIN canaries does not prove equality on every test input

training_reuse.allowed_only_if: Full V1 training accepted, exact case/data/initialization and selected checkpoint/history SHA verified;1548 updates and3epochs complete
training_reuse.counting: A reused trained model is one configuration and seed, not another training replicate
training_reuse.evaluation: All configurations receive the uniform V2 evaluation; V1 per-row evaluation remains a separately labelled channel, never used to fill or improve V2 answers

timing.incomplete_policy: Preserve partials and report k/3; no successful-seed-only average

required_before_execution: New V2 source hashes, cache admission manifest and actual standard contracts
Independent implementation review and CPU negative/serialization tests
Exact owned V1 process cleanup and fresh resource gate
Actual TRAIN-only GPU batch equivalence, memory and throughput qualification
